decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher it remains highly related to the firm's core postpress know-how and service base, so management is likely to keep learning from the product rather than withdraw it.

The UV spot varnishing system is still more distant from the firm's established knowledge base and thus riskier to support and improve, but its strategic relevance for digital print enhancement makes management more likely to retain it for another year than to exit immediately.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing finishing workflow competence, giving strong absorptive capacity and a good basis for continued commercialization.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's long-standing booklet making and binding capabilities, so management would usually keep it in the portfolio unless clear failure emerges.
This folding add-on unit is tightly connected to the installed base and already has a concrete customer application, which makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
